visual_action: A slideshow displays still images of Democratic National Convention stages and crowds from different years. The 2008 photo shows an empty but grandly lit stage. The 2012 and 2016 photos show massive arenas filled with people. The 2020 photo shows Joe Biden, Jill Biden, Kamala Harris, and Doug Emhoff on a much smaller, socially-distanced stage. The video concludes with a large white question mark over the year 2024.
